2. ESTABLISH – NO PARKING, ANY TIME, VEHICLES OVER 7 FEET HIGH
Cambridge Street, north side, from Stoneybrook Avenue to 200 feet easterly (Supervisor District 11)
(Requires approval by the SFMTA Board) Juan Hernandez, [staff email removed — see the order]

Proposal to establish a Parking Restriction to improve STOP sign visibility.

Public Comments: Received email in support prior to public hearing. Comments received during
public hearing regarding the 200-foot length, relocation of tall vehicles to other blocks, double
parking, illegal dumping and other concerns.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer to forward to the SFMTA Board for final approval and
implementation.
